title: Rewrite the six audience doors around their people and actual work

verify.note: Rejects retired setup and growth claims and verifies concrete route-specific tasks remain.

detail: Owner authorized full copy sweep with independent editorial layers. Six distinct audience stories replace unsupported reach, attendance and setup-time claims. Pricing interpolation, routing, plan eligibility and CTA identity remain. Default footer sign-off is Get people together. Do things on purpose.
